_note: Additive offsets applied on top of a look, by detected source type. Looks are calibrated on phone_processed files, so that class has no offsets. The others are UNVERIFIED guesses.

phone_processed.note: Looks are calibrated on these (iPhone HEIC/JPEG edited in Photos).

phone_raw.note: ProRAW/DNG: flatter than the processed file, still some Apple tone mapping baked in.

camera_raw.note: Flat, unprocessed: needs more contrast and some sharpening.

camera_jpeg.note: Already rendered by the camera; treat as neutral.

unknown.note: No EXIF: likely a screenshot or social-media re-save. Be gentle; compression artifacts get exaggerated.
